vintage: INSEE comparateur de territoires, census 2023 and 2024 establishments

lenses.name: Natural population balance
lenses.description: Births minus deaths in 2023 as a share of residents, with commune vital events summed within each map hex. Negative values mean deaths exceed births before migration.

lenses.name: Estimated net migration
lenses.description: Approximate net migration 2017–2023: total population change minus summed natural increase, divided by 2017 population. This residual omits statistical adjustments and is sensitive to municipal boundary changes.

lenses.name: Business establishments
lenses.description: INSEE establishment count in 2024 per 1,000 residents, summed from communes within each map hex. Establishments are local business units, not enterprises or employment.
